categories.name: wallet
categories.rationale: Fixes broken test assertions that allowed keypool restoration tests for non-legacy wallets to pass trivially against untouched wallets. The PR description notes that nodes 2 through 4 never had their wallets replaced with backups, leaving backup recovery assertions ineffective for non-legacy keypool types.
